subject: astronomy
title: Gravity & Orbits: Beyond Planets
welcome_lead: From rockets to galaxies — gravity rules them all.
meta_desc: KS3 astronomy: rockets, escape velocity, galactic gravity.
final_note: Anything with mass plays the gravity game.

concepts.def: Speed needed to leave a planet's pull.
Vehicle that uses thrust to fight gravity.
Huge group of stars held by gravity.
Our home galaxy of ~200 billion stars.
Region with gravity so strong light can't escape.

walkthroughs.body_html: To leave Earth forever you must go at about 11.2 km/s. That's escape velocity. Rockets build up to it stage by stage.
Gravity holds the Milky Way together. Our Sun takes ~225 million years to orbit the centre of the galaxy.
A black hole is so dense that not even light escapes. They form when very massive stars die.
